title: Germany: primary network degraded; allowed alternative operator on same profile

decision.question: Given the cellular connectivity symptoms, diagnostic evidence so far, and only these admissible tools, which next tool is most useful for safely advancing service restoration? Do not assume an unverified recovery path works.

eligible.retry_connection: Bounded backoff and re-attach on the current profile and operator; suits brief or improving disruptions
eligible.try_allowed_operator: Reselect another operator the ACTIVE profile already permits (no profile change); suits a failing serving network
eligible.investigate_data_path: Read-only: check network-side data sessions, APN and application ingestion; suits devices that register but whose telemetry fails
eligible.escalate_or_wait: Hold and hand off to a human with the collected evidence; suits cases no admissible remote action can fix

excluded.investigate_device: devices unreachable; no modem logs retrievable
excluded.evaluate_profile_change: no management path to the IPA; OTA profile change impossible

result.summary: no data sessions; attach failing on DE-NET-1

explanation:
**Observed:**
- Diagnostics showed no PDN sessions, with attach failing on DE-NET-1.
- Device investigation and OTA profile change were unavailable, so the agent chose an allowed-operator switch (p=0.60, confidence 0.47).
- The simulated reselection to DE-NET-2 succeeded. Attach rose from 0.04 to 0.997, data session from 0.03 to 0.99, app ack from 0 to 0.995, and heartbeat from 0.04 to 0.99.
- Two steps over 20 simulated minutes. Profile_A is active, with 0 profile changes, 0 forbidden executions, and 0 blocked calls.

**Uncertain:**
- Root cause of the DE-NET-1 attach failure, since no modem logs were retrievable.
- Whether the reselection would hold on the live network, since this was a simulation.
- Whether DE-NET-2 remains suitable over time.
- No profile switch was attempted, so none is unconfirmed.

result.summary: no data sessions; attach failing on DE-NET-1
